question: What educational institution with the mascot named Washington University Bear did Tennessee Williams go to?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.0c4y8)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.0c4y8 ns:people.person.education ?y .
?y ns:education.education.institution ?x .
?x ns:common.topic.notable_types ns:m.01y2hnl .
?x ns:education.educational_institution.mascot ns:m.0htdhz4 . 
}
SExpr: (AND (JOIN education.educational_institution.mascot m.0htdhz4) (AND (JOIN common.topic.notable_types m.01y2hnl) (JOIN (R education.education.institution) (JOIN (R people.person.education) m.0c4y8))))

question: Who founded New York University, which held his governmental position from after 1795-03-04?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.0bwfn)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.0bwfn ns:organization.organization.founders ?x .
?x ns:government.politician.government_positions_held ?c .
?c ns:government.government_position_held.from ?num .
FILTER (?num > "1795-03-04"^^xsd:dateTime) . 
}

question: Which was the earliest President during WW2 in the United States?
sparql:
#MANUAL SPARQL
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
  ns:m.081pw ns:time.event.start_date ?start ;
             ns:time.event.end_date ?end .
  ?x ns:government.politician.government_positions_held  ?y .
  ?y ns:government.government_position_held.office_position_or_title ns:m.060d2 ; # President of the United States
     ns:government.government_position_held.from  ?from ;
     ns:government.government_position_held.to  ?to .
  FILTER (?from < ?end)
  FILTER (?to > ?start)?x ns:government.politician.government_positions_held ?c .
?c ns:government.government_position_held.from ?num .
}
ORDER BY ?num LIMIT 1

question: Which of JFK's brothers held governmental position from before January 3, 1965?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.0d3k14)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.0d3k14 ns:people.person.sibling_s ?y .
?y ns:people.sibling_relationship.sibling ?x .
?x ns:people.person.gender ns:m.05zppz .
?x ns:government.politician.government_positions_held ?c .
?c ns:government.government_position_held.from ?num .
FILTER (?num < "1965-01-03"^^xsd:dateTime) . 
}
SExpr: (AND (lt (JOIN government.politician.government_positions_held government.government_position_held.from) 1965-01-03^^http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) (AND (JOIN people.person.gender m.05zppz) (JOIN (R people.sibling_relationship.sibling) (JOIN (R people.person.sibling_s) m.0d3k14))))

question: With a mascot named Rocky, which team does Nate Robinson play for?

WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.07c1_2)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.07c1_2 ns:sports.pro_athlete.teams ?y .
?y ns:sports.sports_team_roster.team ?x .

EXISTS {?y ns:sports.sports_team_roster.from ?sk1 . 
FILTER(xsd:datetime(?sk1) <= "2015-08-10"^^xsd:dateTime) })
FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?y ns:sports.sports_team_roster.to ?sk2} ||

question: Which nation has a capital city of South Tarawa and has good exported from Japan?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.03_3d)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.03_3d ns:location.statistical_region.places_exported_to ?y .
?y ns:location.imports_and_exports.exported_to ?x .
?x ns:location.country.capital ns:m.040q6l . 
}

question: Which sports team owned by Stan Kroenke did Nate Robinson play for?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.07c1_2)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.07c1_2 ns:sports.pro_athlete.teams ?y .
?y ns:sports.sports_team_roster.team ?x .
FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?y ns:sports.sports_team_roster.from ?sk0} || 
EXISTS {?y ns:sports.sports_team_roster.from ?sk1 . 
FILTER(xsd:datetime(?sk1) <= "2015-08-10"^^xsd:dateTime) })
FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?y ns:sports.sports_team_roster.to ?sk2} || 
EXISTS {?y ns:sports.sports_team_roster.to ?sk3 . 
FILTER(xsd:datetime(?sk3) >= "2015-08-10"^^xsd:dateTime) })
?x ns:sports.professional_sports_team.owner_s ns:m.0dg6f6 . 
}
SExpr: (AND (JOIN sports.professional_sports_team.owner_s m.0dg6f6) (JOIN (R sports.sports_team_roster.team) (TC (JOIN (R sports.pro_athlete.teams) m.07c1_2) sports.sports_team_roster.from NOW)))

question: What was the last World Series won by the team whose mascot is Lou Seal?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ?c)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
?c ns:sports.sports_team.team_mascot ns:m.03_dwn . 
?c ns:sports.sports_team.championships ?x .
?x ns:time.event.start_date ?sk0 .
}
ORDER BY DESC(xsd:datetime(?sk0))
LIMIT 1

question: Before the Euro, what was the currency where Louis-Eugene Cavaignac was appointed to governmental position?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ?c)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
?c ns:government.governmental_jurisdiction.governing_officials ?k .
?k ns:government.government_position_held.appointed_by ns:m.01dsxn . 
?c ns:location.country.currency_formerly_used ?x .
}

question: What museum that opened later than 1891 should I visit when I go to Vienna, Austria next year?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.0fhp9)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.0fhp9 ns:travel.travel_destination.tourist_attractions ?x .
?x ns:architecture.museum.established ?num .
FILTER (?num > "1891"^^xsd:dateTime) . 
}

question: What college did President Kennedy attend that has a sports team Princeton Tigers men's basketball?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.0d3k14)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.0d3k14 ns:people.person.education ?y .
?y ns:education.education.institution ?x .
?x ns:education.educational_institution.sports_teams ns:m.0bmh27j . 
}

?c ns:location.country.form_of_government ?x .
}

ns:m.07c1_2 ns:sports.pro_athlete.teams ?y .
?y ns:sports.sports_team_roster.team ?x .
FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?y ns:sports.sports_team_roster.from ?sk0} || 
EXISTS {?y ns:sports.sports_team_roster.from ?sk1 . 
FILTER(xsd:datetime(?sk1) <= "2015-08-10"^^xsd:dateTime) })
FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?y ns:sports.sports_team_roster.to ?sk2} ||

question: In what Eastern Time Zone does Lala Anthony live?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.03l26m)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.03l26m ns:people.person.places_lived ?y .
?y ns:people.place_lived.location ?x .
FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?y ns:people.place_lived.end_date ?sk0} || 
EXISTS {?y ns:people.place_lived.end_date ?sk1 . 
FILTER(xsd:datetime(?sk1) >= "2015-08-10"^^xsd:dateTime) })
FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?y ns:people.place_lived.start_date ?sk2} || 
EXISTS {?y ns:people.place_lived.start_date ?sk3 . 
FILTER(xsd:datetime(?sk3) <= "2015-08-10"^^xsd:dateTime) })
?x ns:location.location.time_zones ns:m.02hcv8 . 
}
SExpr: (AND (JOIN location.location.time_zones m.02hcv8) (JOIN (R people.place_lived.location) (TC (JOIN (R people.person.places_lived) m.03l26m) people.place_lived.end_date NOW)))

}

ns:m.03l26m ns:people.person.places_lived ?y .

FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?y ns:people.place_lived.start_date ?sk2} ||

?c ns:location.country.national_anthem ?k .
?k ns:government.national_anthem_of_a_country.anthem ns:m.01nrft . 
?c ns:government.governmental_jurisdiction.governing_officials ?y .
?y ns:government.government_position_held.office_holder ?x .
?y ns:government.government_position_held.basic_title ns:m.0fkx3 .
FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?y ns:government.government_position_held.from ?sk0} ||

FILTER(xsd:datetime(?sk1) <= "1948-12-31"^^xsd:dateTime) })
FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?y ns:government.government_position_held.to ?sk2} ||

}

question: Where did the "Beat The Summer Tour" artist graduate college?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ?c)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
?c ns:music.artist.concert_tours ns:m.0wfrv9g . 
?c ns:people.person.education ?y .
?y ns:education.education.institution ?x .
?x ns:common.topic.notable_types ns:m.01y2hnl .
?y ns:education.education.degree ns:m.019v9k .
}
SExpr: (AND (JOIN common.topic.notable_types m.01y2hnl) (JOIN (R education.education.institution) (AND (JOIN education.education.degree m.019v9k) (JOIN (R people.person.education) (JOIN music.artist.concert_tours m.0wfrv9g)))))

question: Which German bordering country appointed Georges Pompidou to governmental position?

PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.0345h)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.0345h ns:location.location.adjoin_s ?y .
?y ns:location.adjoining_relationship.adjoins ?x .
?x ns:common.topic.notable_types ns:m.01mp .
?x ns:government.governmental_jurisdiction.governing_officials ?c .
?c ns:government.government_position_held.appointed_by ns:m.01lbpj .

question: Who did the voice of Jack Skellington and plays Kurotowa?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.042zz0)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.042zz0 ns:film.film_character.portrayed_in_films ?y .
?y ns:film.performance.actor ?x .
?y ns:film.performance.special_performance_type ns:m.02nsjvf .
?x ns:film.actor.dubbing_performances ?c .
?c ns:film.dubbing_performance.character ns:m.0hg35kz . 
}
SExpr: (AND (JOIN film.actor.dubbing_performances (JOIN film.dubbing_performance.character m.0hg35kz)) (JOIN (R film.performance.actor) (AND (JOIN film.performance.special_performance_type m.02nsjvf) (JOIN (R film.film_character.portrayed_in_films) m.042zz0))))

question: What was the name of the president during World War II who left the position after April 12, 1945?
sparql:
#MANUAL SPARQL
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
  ns:m.081pw ns:time.event.start_date ?start ;
             ns:time.event.end_date ?end .
  ?x ns:government.politician.government_positions_held  ?y .
  ?y ns:government.government_position_held.office_position_or_title ns:m.060d2 ; # President of the United States
     ns:government.government_position_held.from  ?from ;
     ns:government.government_position_held.to  ?to .
  FILTER (?from < ?end)
  FILTER (?to > ?start)?x ns:government.politician.government_positions_held ?c .
?c ns:government.government_position_held.to ?num .
FILTER (?num > "1945-04-12"^^xsd:dateTime) . 
}

question: What governor of Arizona in 2009 ended his/her governmental position earliest?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.0vmt)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.0vmt ns:government.governmental_jurisdiction.governing_officials ?y .
?y ns:government.government_position_held.office_holder ?x .
?y ns:government.government_position_held.basic_title ns:m.0fkvn .
FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?y ns:government.government_position_held.from ?sk0} || 
EXISTS {?y ns:government.government_position_held.from ?sk1 . 
FILTER(xsd:datetime(?sk1) <= "2009-12-31"^^xsd:dateTime) })
FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?y ns:government.government_position_held.to ?sk2} || 
EXISTS {?y ns:government.government_position_held.to ?sk3 . 
FILTER(xsd:datetime(?sk3) >= "2009-01-01"^^xsd:dateTime) })
?x ns:government.politician.government_positions_held ?c .
?c ns:government.government_position_held.to ?num .
}
ORDER BY ?num LIMIT 1

ns:m.06qjgc ns:sports.pro_athlete.teams ?y .
?y ns:sports.sports_team_roster.team ?x .
FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?y ns:sports.sports_team_roster.from ?sk0} || 
EXISTS {?y ns:sports.sports_team_roster.from ?sk1 . 
FILTER(xsd:datetime(?sk1) <= "2010-12-31"^^xsd:dateTime) })
FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?y ns:sports.sports_team_roster.to ?sk2} ||

}

FILTER (?x != ns:m.09bg4l)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.09bg4l ns:people.person.education ?y .
?y ns:education.education.institution ?x .
?x ns:common.topic.notable_types ns:m.01y2hnl .
?x ns:education.university.number_of_undergraduates ?c .
?c ns:measurement_unit.dated_integer.number ?num .

question: Of the countries in Eastern Europe, which has the smallest country calling code?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.09b69)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.09b69 ns:location.location.contains ?x .
?x ns:common.topic.notable_types ns:m.01mp .
?x ns:location.country.calling_code ?num .
}
ORDER BY xsd:integer(?num) LIMIT 1

ns:m.05nrg ns:location.location.contains ?x .

FILTER (?x != ns:m.0dl567)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.0dl567 ns:film.actor.film ?y .
?y ns:film.performance.film ?x .
?x ns:film.film.starring ?c .
?c ns:film.performance.actor ns:m.016qtt . 
}

question: What is the earliest founded college that Russell Wilson attended?

PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.05c10yf)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.05c10yf ns:people.person.education ?y .
?y ns:education.education.institution ?x .
?x ns:common.topic.notable_types ns:m.01y2hnl .
?x ns:organization.organization.date_founded ?num .
}

ns:m.09b69 ns:location.location.contains ?x .

question: What location did the artist Seal and the actress feature in the film MTV: Uncensored: Sports Illustrated Swimsuit Issue 2001 get married?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ?c)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
?c ns:film.actor.film ?k .
?k ns:film.performance.film ns:m.0crsjfx . 
?c ns:people.person.spouse_s ?y .
?y ns:people.marriage.location_of_ceremony ?x .
?y ns:people.marriage.spouse ns:m.01vsykc .
?y ns:people.marriage.type_of_union ns:m.04ztj .
}
SExpr: (JOIN (R people.marriage.location_of_ceremony) (AND (JOIN people.marriage.type_of_union m.04ztj) (AND (JOIN people.marriage.spouse m.01vsykc) (JOIN (R people.person.spouse_s) (JOIN film.actor.film (JOIN film.performance.film m.0crsjfx))))))

question: Which university with 5358 postgraduates did Harry S Truman attend?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.09bg4l)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.09bg4l ns:people.person.education ?y .
?y ns:education.education.institution ?x .
?x ns:common.topic.notable_types ns:m.01y2hnl .
?x ns:education.university.number_of_postgraduates ?c .
?c ns:measurement_unit.dated_integer.number "5358" . 
}
SExpr: (AND (JOIN education.university.number_of_postgraduates (JOIN measurement_unit.dated_integer.number "5358")) (AND (JOIN common.topic.notable_types m.01y2hnl) (JOIN (R education.education.institution) (JOIN (R people.person.education) m.09bg4l))))

ns:m.08l257 ns:film.actor.film ?y .

question: Which countries does Germany border, whose population is smaller than 9,153,489?

PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.0345h)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.0345h ns:location.location.adjoin_s ?y .
?y ns:location.adjoining_relationship.adjoins ?x .
?x ns:common.topic.notable_types ns:m.01mp .
?x ns:topic_server.population_number ?num .
FILTER (xsd:integer(?num) < 9153489) . 
}
SExpr: (AND (lt topic_server.population_number 9153489) (AND (JOIN common.topic.notable_types m.01mp) (JOIN (R location.adjoining_relationship.adjoins) (JOIN (R location.location.adjoin_s) m.0345h))))

question: Where does LaLa Anthony live, and where an 1982 honorary degree recipient was born?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.03l26m)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.03l26m ns:people.person.places_lived ?y .
?y ns:people.place_lived.location ?x .
FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?y ns:people.place_lived.end_date ?sk0} || 
EXISTS {?y ns:people.place_lived.end_date ?sk1 . 
FILTER(xsd:datetime(?sk1) >= "2015-08-10"^^xsd:dateTime) })
FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?y ns:people.place_lived.start_date ?sk2} || 
EXISTS {?y ns:people.place_lived.start_date ?sk3 . 
FILTER(xsd:datetime(?sk3) <= "2015-08-10"^^xsd:dateTime) })
?x ns:location.location.people_born_here ?c .
?c ns:education.honorary_degree.awarded_on "1982"^^xsd:dateTime . 
}
SExpr: (AND (JOIN location.location.people_born_here (JOIN education.honorary_degree.awarded_on 1982^^http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime)) (JOIN (R people.place_lived.location) (TC (JOIN (R people.person.places_lived) m.03l26m) people.place_lived.end_date NOW)))

question: Which country with an internet top level domain is in the Caribbean?

PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.0261m)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.0261m ns:location.location.contains ?x .
?x ns:common.topic.notable_types ns:m.01mp .
?x ns:location.country.internet_tld ns:m.02vr7m . 
}

question: Of the colleges attended by Harry S. Truman, which has the smallest number of undergraduates?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.09bg4l)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.09bg4l ns:people.person.education ?y .
?y ns:education.education.institution ?x .
?x ns:common.topic.notable_types ns:m.01y2hnl .
?x ns:education.university.number_of_undergraduates ?c .
?c ns:measurement_unit.dated_integer.number ?num .
}
ORDER BY xsd:integer(?num) LIMIT 1
SExpr: (ARGMIN (AND (JOIN common.topic.notable_types m.01y2hnl) (JOIN (R education.education.institution) (JOIN (R people.person.education) m.09bg4l))) (JOIN education.university.number_of_undergraduates measurement_unit.dated_integer.number))

question: What college, founded on 24 February 1893, did Paul Ryan attend?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.024v2j)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.024v2j ns:people.person.education ?y .
?y ns:education.education.institution ?x .
?x ns:common.topic.notable_types ns:m.01y2hnl .
?x ns:organization.organization.date_founded "1893-02-24"^^xsd:dateTime . 
}
SExpr: (AND (JOIN organization.organization.date_founded 1893-02-24^^http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) (AND (JOIN common.topic.notable_types m.01y2hnl) (JOIN (R education.education.institution) (JOIN (R people.person.education) m.024v2j))))

sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>

WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.0vmt)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.0vmt ns:government.governmental_jurisdiction.governing_officials ?y .
?y ns:government.government_position_held.office_holder ?x .

FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?y ns:government.government_position_held.from ?sk0} || 
EXISTS {?y ns:government.government_position_held.from ?sk1 . 
FILTER(xsd:datetime(?sk1) <= "2009-12-31"^^xsd:dateTime) })
FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?y ns:government.government_position_held.to ?sk2} || 
EXISTS {?y ns:government.government_position_held.to ?sk3 . 
FILTER(xsd:datetime(?sk3) >= "2009-01-01"^^xsd:dateTime) })
?x ns:government.politician.party ?c .
?c ns:government.political_party_tenure.party ns:m.0d075m . 
}

question: What event with less than 30,000 casualties happened at Dunkirk in WW2?
sparql:
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?x
WHERE {
FILTER (?x != ns:m.0md6f)
FILTER (!isLiteral(?x) OR lang(?x) = '' OR langMatches(lang(?x), 'en'))
ns:m.0md6f ns:location.location.events ?x .
?x ns:time.event.included_in_event ns:m.081pw .
?x ns:military.military_conflict.casualties ?c .
?c ns:military.casualties.lower_estimate ?num .
FILTER (xsd:integer(?num) < 30000) . 
}
